description: Generate and integrate the required Chibi Quest and Riven Lands production asset packs across every current Advantage Play Kit cartridge and edition.
deviation_notes: Corrects the APK program completion claim: W0-W4 proved architecture and gameplay with procedural placeholders, but the product remains incomplete until both required dual-theme packs replace those placeholders.

sprint.goal: Every current APK cartridge renders production Chibi Quest and Riven Lands artwork through validated, versioned edition manifests with no procedural placeholder assets.
